listings.title: Fixed 2 Move is in Wyncote
listings.description: Fixed 2 Move is pleased to present an exceptional estate sale in Wyncote, PA, featuring a curated selection of fine home furnishings, art glass, and decorative collectibles. Highlighted furniture offerings include a rustic wooden cabinet with a raised gallery backsplash, a Mission-style oak rocking chair complete with plush green patterned cushions, and a vintage Thonet-style bentwood rocking chair featuring classic woven cane back and seat panels. Collectors of mid-century and artistic accents will appreciate a vintage Fernand Léger printed ceramic decorative plate in a modern Cubist style, a Gaudí-style colorful enamel frog figurine, and a hand-painted Chinese porcelain fishbowl planter complete with its wooden stand. Many pieces of art from Picasso to Chagall to modern artist currently exhibited in NY. The sale also includes a diverse array of fine glassware, studio ceramics, and unique international folk art. Notable pieces include a Scandinavian modern etched crystal teardrop vase depicting a bird on a branch, a vintage frosted cranberry glass decanter set with six matching glasses, dark amethyst glass, and vibrant hobnail accents. Additional unique finds feature hand-carved live-edge olive wood bowls, hand-painted South American trinket boxes, studio pottery, and charming decorative cat figurines. Also, do not miss the women's clothing and jewelry. Join us for this wonderful shopping event; cash, Venmo, Cashapp and credit cards will be accepted on-site.

listings.title: Cobalt Blues, Kangaroos and Needle Points Toooooo
listings.description: Are you preparing to host loved ones this holiday season? Allow us to elevate your celebrations with an extraordinary estate event. Discover exquisite collections of full fine china sets , festive Christmas Lenox , premium glassware, elegant table linens, and high-end kitchen essentials—including premium crock pots and sophisticated gadgets designed to make your holiday culinary creations both effortless to prepare and breathtaking to display. For the dining room, an impeccable dining set complete with eight chairs and expandable leaves awaits your family gatherings, while brand-new, boxed folding tables and chairs stand ready to comfortably accommodate every unexpected guest. For the discerning collector, this residence holds truly remarkable treasures. Marvel at a breathtaking, comprehensive collection of cobalt blue glass spanning every imaginable shape and size—perfect for sourcing unforgettable, one-of-a-kind holiday gifts. Delve into an astonishing, whimsical archive featuring hundreds of kangaroo-themed pieces , ranging from fine archival art to nostalgic vintage toys. Equal parts heartwarming and rare, the home also features an extensive array of dog-themed decor and curiosities. Among the most magnificent highlights of this estate are the unbelievable handcrafted needlepoints . Proudly displayed and shoppable, these intricate works of art are ready to be framed as heirloom masterpieces, transformed into bespoke decorative pillows, or integrated into your favorite upholstery. Venture further to discover exceptional indoor and outdoor furniture, including luxurious teakwood sets , vibrant estate plants, classic Adirondack chairs, ornamental pots, artisanal birdhouses, and a striking copper-themed park bench —ideal for crisp autumn evenings spent around the fire pit. Indoors, the home offers high-quality bedroom suites, plush sofas, and premium exercise equipment. For entertainment enthusiasts, closets can be instantly stocked for rainy days with an expansive library of books, VHS tapes, DVDs, and CDs, alongside vintage audio equipment including premium speakers, receivers, and a classic record player. listings.title: American Furniture, Folk & Decorative Arts
listings.description: The November 12th American Furniture, Folk and Decorative Arts auction will feature many exceptional works from important collections, including the Estate of Ambassador J. William Middendorf II of Rhode Island, the Wister Family of Philadelphia and the railroad tycoon Edwin Hawley of New York. The auction is comprised of material dating from the 17th century to the early 20th century, illustrating the breadth of American material culture before our nation’s founding through the Industrial Revolution, when the strength of American manufacturing takes hold. Portraits and medallions of American forefathers George Washington, Thomas Jefferson and Benjamin Franklin, are incorporated amongst other sitters of lesser renown. The artists who executed these works include Gilbert Stuart, Jean-Baptiste Nini, Charles Willson Peale and many others. The auction will also showcase silver by important makers Tiffany & Co., John McMullin, and Myer Myers. Many pieces across the auction come with histories of ownership in which objects have been passed down through generations. In addition, the auction includes a 200 year old cannon believed to have been cast at Paul Revere’s foundry, an extremely rare 1932 C.F. Martin & Co. custom ordered guitar and a rare pair of exceptional Philadelphia Chippendale side chairs.

listings.title: Musical Instruments
listings.description: The Musical Instruments Auction features collectible guitars, vintage amplifiers, professional recording equipment, synthesizers, brass instruments, and audio accessories. A featured offering is the Ampex Model 440 professional reel-to-reel tape recorder with Ampex electronics, cataloged as originating from New York City's Record Plant recording studio. From the collection of Frank Annunziata, the recorder is associated with the studio's recording history. A separate selection of recorded tape reels from Annunziata's studio is also included. Electric guitars feature Rickenbacker 350/V63, 360/12C63, and 325 models, Gretsch Country Classic and Tennessee Rose, and Fender Telecaster, Stratocaster, Mustang, and Jaguar instruments. Other makers include Gibson, Epiphone, PRS, Music Man, Danelectro, and ESP. Acoustic instruments include C.F. Martin guitars, a Gibson Hummingbird Pro twelve-string, Gibson mandolins, and a Vega Pete Seeger banjo. Brass and woodwind offerings include a Selmer Mark VI baritone saxophone and Bach Stradivarius trumpet. Vintage audio equipment includes Vox AC30, Hiwatt Custom 50, TASCAM, TEAC, and PreSonus equipment, alongside Korg synthesizers, professional microphones, and recording accessories. Explore collectible instruments and vintage studio equipment, including the historically significant Ampex Model 440 reel-to-reel recorder.
